items.title: File Einspruch against 2023 income tax assessment
items.quote: Sie können diesen Bescheid binnen eines Monats nach seiner Bekanntgabe mit dem Einspruch anfechten, der schriftlich, elektronisch oder zur Niederschrift bei der erlassenden Stelle einzulegen ist.
items.computation: Letter is dated 10.12.2024 (Tuesday) and sent as simple letter ('einfacher Brief'). Per §122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO, a letter sent by ordinary mail is deemed delivered (Bekanntgabe) on the third day after posting, assumed here to be the document date. 10.12.2024 + 3 days = 13.12.2024 (Friday), which is a business day (not a Saturday, Sunday or NW public holiday), so the Bekanntgabe-fiction date stands at 13.12.2024. The one-month Einspruch period under §355 AO is computed per §§187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB (via §108 AO): the day of the event (13.12.2024) is excluded, and the period ends on the day of the following month bearing the same number, i.e. 13.01.2025. 13.01.2025 is a Monday, not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday, so no extension under §193 BGB applies. Final deadline: 13.01.2025.

warnings: The exact posting date is not stated separately from the document date; the deadline calculation assumes the letter was posted on 10.12.2024, the printed document date — if actual posting occurred later, the Einspruch deadline would shift accordingly.

The 627,00 € refund will reportedly be transferred automatically by the tax office to the account on file; no due date is given for this in the letter and the recipient should verify their bank details are current with the Finanzamt.
